positioning.oneLine: Apple Watch voice capture with a local macOS Codex Watch companion.
positioning.description: Records on Apple Watch, keeps audio on-wrist until a paired Mac is available, transfers over authenticated local HTTPS, transcribes with on-device Apple Speech, and inserts the transcript into a local Codex App Server Inbox thread named Codex Watch. The Mac companion is a user-facing window plus the existing LaunchAgent listener. This is not ChatGPT.app delivery and is not affiliated with OpenAI.

capabilities.claim: Records a voice memo on Apple Watch and keeps it in a durable on-wrist queue while the Mac is unavailable.
Pairs over local network with a certificate phrase and one-time code, then uploads over authenticated HTTPS.
Transcribes on-device with Apple Speech and never falls back to cloud audio recognition.
Shows a user-facing macOS Codex Watch window for pairing, Speech authorization, inbox status, and retry while the LaunchAgent owns the listener.
Inserts transcript text into a local Codex App Server Inbox thread; raw audio is not part of that request.

limitations: Physical Apple Watch capture and the complete Watch-to-Mac workflow remain blocked:external.
Codex delivery is a local App Server Inbox thread named Codex Watch, not ChatGPT.app.
Speech recognition must be authorized for the installed Mac app signature; the LaunchAgent cannot show that prompt.
The Watch app is distributed as source; App Store, TestFlight, and review are unverified.
The user-facing Mac window and current Watch pairing copy live on unmerged branch work until merged to main.
safetyBoundaries: Never submits raw audio to Codex.
Never falls back to cloud transcription.
Pairing credentials stay in Watch Keychain; do not rotate the live Mac TLS identity as a pairing reset.
Diagnostic logs must not contain memo content, transcripts, paths, or pairing secrets.
Not affiliated with or endorsed by OpenAI.
